mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, product_id, type, order_method, price, quantity, remaining_quantity, status, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET remaining_quantity = #{remainingQuantity}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
